target_markets.label: Urban Commuters
target_markets.description: Young to mid-career adults who live in dense cities and walk or take public transit daily. They want shoes that look good at the office and feel good on long commutes.
target_markets.life_stage: Single or partnered, no kids or very young kids
target_markets.activity_level: Walks daily; light gym or classes 1-3 times per week
shoe_needs_focus: All-day comfort for walking and standing
Versatile style for office and social events
Durable soles and materials for city use
notes_for_sampling: Mix of comfort-first and style-forward personas

target_markets.label: Performance-Focused Runners
target_markets.description: Runners who care about pace, distance, and training plans. They read reviews and compare technical specs before buying.
target_markets.life_stage: Mixed; single, partnered, or with kids
target_markets.location_type: Urban or suburban, with access to parks or tracks
target_markets.activity_level: Runs 2-6 times per week; may race occasionally
shoe_needs_focus: Cushioning and support tuned to running style

target_markets.label: Budget-Conscious Family Shoppers
target_markets.description: Parents who buy shoes for themselves and their kids, trying to stretch budgets while avoiding obviously poor quality.
target_markets.activity_level: On feet a lot for work and errands; limited formal exercise time
target_markets.style_orientation: Practical and conservative; prefers neutral designs
notes_for_sampling: Price-sensitive personas, wary of premium pitches
Strong barriers around risk and returns

target_markets.label: Style-Driven Sneaker Enthusiasts
target_markets.description: Younger consumers who see sneakers as part of identity and social signaling. They track drops, trends, and collaborations.
target_markets.income_level: Low to medium, but willing to splurge on shoes
shoe_needs_focus: Comfort acceptable but not primary driver
notes_for_sampling: Social proof and scarcity are key triggers

target_markets.label: Trail and Outdoor Adventurers
target_markets.description: People who hike, trail run, and spend weekends outdoors. They care about traction, weather resistance, and durability.
profession_types: varied; may skew toward outdoorsy and flexible jobs
target_markets.activity_level: Hikes or trail runs weekly or monthly
target_markets.style_orientation: Functional outdoor look; okay with rugged style
shoe_needs_focus: Grip and traction on varied terrain

target_markets.label: Service and Retail Workers on Their Feet
target_markets.description: People who stand or walk for most of their working day in hospitality, retail, or healthcare support roles.
target_markets.activity_level: High step count at work; limited structured exercise
target_markets.style_orientation: Simple and professional; often constrained by dress codes
notes_for_sampling: Very risk-averse about wasting money on bad shoes

target_markets.label: Fashion-Forward City Tastemakers
target_markets.description: Urban consumers who follow fashion, care about curation, and pay attention to how shoes pair with outfits and social settings.
target_markets.style_orientation: Fashion-first; appreciates unique silhouettes and stories
shoe_needs_focus: Brand and story alignment with self-image
notes_for_sampling: Responsive to tone and visual vibe more than specs

target_markets.label: Eco-Mindful Minimalists
target_markets.description: Consumers who care about sustainability, owning fewer but better items, and ethical manufacturing.
target_markets.life_stage: Mixed; often urban professionals or remote workers
target_markets.activity_level: Walks frequently; may bike or do light running/yoga

target_markets.label: Mature Comfort-First Seekers
target_markets.description: Older adults who prioritize comfort, support, and stability over style trends.
notes_for_sampling: Prefers clear, larger text and high clarity

target_markets.label: Foot-Health Priority Buyers
target_markets.description: Consumers with foot issues (plantar fasciitis, flat feet, past injuries) who see shoes as a health tool.
target_markets.income_level: Low to medium to high; willing to spend for relief
profession_types: mixed; often jobs requiring standing or past sports history
target_markets.activity_level: Walking and low-impact exercise; limited high-impact sports
target_markets.style_orientation: Function-over-fashion; appreciates if style is decent
notes_for_sampling: High need for proof, testimonials, or expert cues
